result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signal control on a wide one-way street. While painted buffers with flex posts are used to narrow the roadway and provide some daylighting, the overall crossing distance remains significant for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: Concrete Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace the painted buffer and flex posts with permanent concrete bulb-outs to further shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the crossing lacks signalization and features significant visual obstructions from parked vehicles near the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on both sides of the street block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street leading up to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: The foreground crosswalk spanning the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The environment features a wide, high-visibility zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks with curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian access. However, the lack of a median refuge and visible pedestrian signals increases exposure risk for people crossing the multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection to indicate safe crossing times.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the traffic light pole

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with essential pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, the environment lacks physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions, and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars and the large vehicle in the foreground block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the curb line near the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of physical protection
hazards.description: The absence of curb extensions or bollards leaves pedestrians exposed at the corner and increases the crossing distance.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.
